sentences.text:
Counsel for Applicant :- Chandrajeet,Swati Agrawal Srivastava Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.
Hon'ble Vivek Varma,J.
Heard learned counsel for the applicant and Sri Vikas Sahai, learned A.G.A. for the State.

The instant bail application, under Section 439 Cr.P.C., has been filed with a prayer to enlarge the applicant on bail in Case Crime No. 487 of 2022, under Sections 420, 467, 468, 471, 120-B I.P.C.,
Police Station- Phase-III, District- Gautam Buddha Nagar.
It is contended that the applicant has been falsely implicated in the instant case.
The applicant was not named in the first informant report.
The role of installation of camera in various hotels and capturing obscene photographs of the guests at hotel has been assigned to co-accused Abdul Wahab and Vishnu Singh.
The name of the applicant was disclosed by the co-accused Pankaj in police custody.
The said statement in so far as it implicates the applicant is unreliable.
Prosecution evidence does not connect the applicant with the offence.

The allegation that the co-accused Pankaj used to provide forged sims to the applicant through which calls were made and money was Anurag Kumar vs State Of U.P. on 19 January, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/103288475/
1 collected is false, as the sims through which calls were made were registered in the name of Pankaj.

entities.text: Anurag Kumar vs State Of U.P.
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: The applicant is not the beneficiary of any illicit transaction.
No amount has been credited in the account of the applicant.
It is further contended that the applicant has not made any call to the informant.
The role of the applicant is clearly distinguishable from that of the co-accused Abdul Wahab, Wasim and Pankaj.
The applicant does not have any criminal history and is in jail since 21.10.2022.
In case, he is enlarged on bail, he will not misuse the liberty of bail.
Learned A.G.A. has opposed the prayer for bail but could not satisfactorily dispute the aforesaid submissions from the record.
Having regard to the submissions made but without commenting on merits of the case, I am of the opinion that the applicant is entitled to be enlarged on bail.
In case of breach of any of the above conditions, the prosecution shall be at liberty to move bail cancellation application before this Court.

Order Date :- 19.1.2023 S.S.
